descriptor: A virtual STEM lab that finds the wrong idea behind every mistake, then builds the experiment that breaks it.

hero.question: Which falls
hero.setup: Two balls, same size. The steel one is three times heavier than the glass one. Make your call, then we drop them.
hero.scrollHint: Scroll to see how Ano works

chapters.title: Predict
chapters.body: Every experiment starts with your guess. You make the call before you press run, so your idea is on the record.

chapters.title: Diagnose
chapters.body: Guess wrong and Ano replays your build through the mistaken ideas students often hold, until one of them predicts exactly what you did.

chapters.title: Break
chapters.body: Ano picks the one small change where that idea and reality disagree the most. You run it, and the idea cracks.

chapters.title: Rebuild
chapters.body: Fix the build, run it again, keep the idea that survived. Chemistry and robotics, right in the browser.

labs.title: Pick an
labs.body: Short builds, one prediction each. Get one wrong and Ano finds the idea behind it.

captions.landing: Two hits, at the same moment
